newsitem.title: USA: BioQuest to buy DNA diagnostics firm.
newsitem.headline: BioQuest to buy DNA diagnostics firm.

text.p: BioQuest Inc said it signed a letter of intent to buy privately-owned Immune Complex Corp of San Diego for an undisclosed amount of cash.
BioQuest said in a statement it would divulge terms of the deal after it completed due diligence and finalized paperwork.

Immune Complex owns three issued patents covering vaccine delivery enabling technology, which complement the patents held by BioQuest relating to HIV vaccine technology, the statement said. Immune's patents also are applicable to a range of new infectious disease vaccines, it added.
